status: PASS IMPLEMENTED AND MEASURED 2026-10-03. ai/bias_pass.py + tests/bias/test_bias_pass.py, 18 assertions, all passing.
keyword_list_sha_note: SHA-256 of keyword_terms.json as committed. If the term list changes and this does not, the set is stale and the checker fails. Regenerate with scripts/verify_bias_set.py.

files.keyword_terms.json: 62 proposed terms in 8 groups, plus 6 deliberately-excluded terms and 5 known limitations
files.rationale_cases.jsonl: 10 must-flag cases, category 8 (LLM pass only, not CI-gated)

synthetic_note: Every case is invented. Institution and role names are real organisations; no individual, employer or real resume is represented. Amazon-style cases reproduce the SHAPE of the 2018 proxy pattern with invented wording, recording the derivation in each case's source_pattern. No third-party text is reproduced here.

pass_criteria.llm_pass_note: The LLM bias pass is advisory and is not asserted in CI. An advisory signal is allowed to be wrong; gating CI on it makes the suite flaky and invites disabling it.

measured.caveat: Recall of 1.0 on a set whose term list was authored alongside the cases is close to tautological and proves very little. The figures that carry information are the ZERO false positives, which show the six deliberate exclusions hold, and the flag rate landing inside [0.60, 0.95], which shows the pass is not simply flagging everything. This is a fixture result, not evidence about real candidates or about the ranking model.
measured.verified_in_this_environment: Executed via a minimal pytest shim, because this environment has no pytest installed and installing one was not authorised. The assertions ran and all passed; CI runs the real pytest.
measured.negative_tested: The implementation was broken three ways on purpose and the suite was required to fail each time: dropping apostrophe folding, matching every term unconditionally, and swallowing the missing-term-list exception. The first two were caught. The THIRD was not -- every test supplied an explicit set directory, so the missing-file branch was never exercised -- and that is the worst failure mode the pass has, since a pass with no terms flags nothing and looks exactly like success. The two guarding tests (test_missing_term_list_fails_loudly, test_no_versioned_set_fails_loudly) were added in response, and the third regression now fails as it should.

measured_note: NO PASS RATE HAS BEEN MEASURED. There is no bias pass implementation in the repository yet. Every number in pass_criteria is a target. scripts/verify_bias_set.py proves the fixture set is internally consistent; it does not prove the pass works.
does_not_support: any claim that the product is bias-free or unbiased
any conclusion about the embedding model or the ranking function
